title: Ethics Practices in AI Development: An Empirical Study Across Roles and Regions
abstract: arXiv:2508.09219v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent advances in AI applications have raised growing concerns about the need for ethical guidelines and regulations to mitigate the risks posed by these technologies. In this paper, we present a mixed-methods survey study - combining statistical and qualitative analyses - to examine the ethical perceptions, practices, and knowledge of individuals involved in various AI development roles. Our survey comprises 414 participants from 43 countries, representing various roles such as AI managers, analysts, developers, quality assurance professionals, and information security and privacy experts. The results reveal varying degrees of familiarity and experience with AI ethics principles, government initiatives, and risk mitigation strategies across roles, regions, and other demographic factors. translated_title: AI开发中的伦理实践：跨角色与区域的实证研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2508.09219v3 公告类型：替换-交叉  摘要：近年来，AI应用的进展引发了人们对伦理指南和法规需求的日益关注，以减轻这些技术带来的风险。在本文中，我们提出了一项混合方法调查研究——结合统计和定性分析——以考察参与各种AI开发角色的个体的伦理认知、实践和知识。我们的调查包括来自43个国家的414名参与者，代表各种角色，如AI经理、分析师、开发者、质量保证专业人员以及信息安全与隐私专家。结果揭示了在不同角色、区域和其他人口统计因素中，对AI伦理原则、政府倡议和风险缓解策略的熟悉程度和经验存在差异。我们的发现强调了协作性、角色敏感的方法的重要性，该方法涉及多元利益相关者在伦理决策中的参与。
tldr: 本研究通过大规模跨国调查，揭示了AI开发中不同角色和地区在伦理认知与实践上的差异，并强调了多方协作和角色敏感决策的必要性。
en_tdlr: This study, through a large-scale cross-national survey, reveals variations in ethical perceptions and practices across AI development roles and regions, emphasizing the need for collaborative and role-sensitive decision-making.
